review_scope: Four first accessible medium photos for each of the 15 species that may reach the 12-image threshold; contact sheets are in inat-review-sheets artifact.
reviewer_method: Visual first-pass by an AI assistant; not expert botanical verification.

examples_requiring_review.flag: Plant of interest very small within tree/background; poor framing for classification.
Plant of interest occupies only a small portion of a wide outdoor photo.
Leaf appearance in sample visually uncertain; verify identification with a botanist before use.
No diagnostic flower detail visible in sample; check species identification before use.

data_quality_observations: Many candidates are outdoor or wild-habitat photos; consumer use case is close phone photos of potted houseplants, so validation must account for the domain shift.
Separate iNaturalist observation IDs can show the same individual or photographer; train/validation should be grouped by source contributor and individual plant when feasible.
Photographic access and CC0/CC-BY metadata do not prove correct species labels.
decision: None of these 60 samples or the 189 decoded photos are promoted automatically to labeled training data. Trained classes remain 101; independent phone-photo accuracy unmeasured.
